result.note: A political ultimatum, but it carries one durable polity fact stated in the story: only Parliament can remove the Chief Election Commissioner.

questions.prompt: In September 2026, the Cockroach Janta Party demanded the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over alleged voter-roll manipulation. Which body alone can remove the Chief Election Commissioner from office?
questions.explain: Parliament alone can remove the Chief Election Commissioner, so the party's 48-hour ultimatum carries no power to force him out. The demand was made over alleged manipulation of voter rolls.
questions.source: testing a movement that won in July against an official Parliament alone can remove.
